stem: A required receiving weight was missed, but a worker remembers an approximate number. What should the record show?
choices: Enter the remembered receiving weight at the original time and mark it as approximate.
Copy the outgoing weight because it is the closest controlled quantity available.
Use the planned target quantity so the receiving record remains complete.
Use the controlled missing-data or late-entry process and do not present a remembered or substituted value as the original receiving measurement.
rationale: A missed receiving measurement cannot be recreated honestly by memory, target, or substitution from another record. The controlled missing-data or late-entry process preserves the fact that the original value was not captured at the required time and prevents false precision from entering the traceability record.
